about.title: Bridging the Gap Between Soil and Table
about.subtitle: Farm2Market was engineered to dismantle legacy supply chain inefficiencies and return agricultural prosperity to Indian farmers.
about.storyP1: In traditional agricultural supply chains, farmers often receive as little as 20-30% of the retail price paid by end consumers, with intermediaries capturing the majority of profit margins.
about.storyP2: Farm2Market provides a transparent, multilingual, GPS-enabled digital platform that enables direct transaction, verified farm listing, and instant digital payments.
about.missionDesc: To maximize farmer earnings by providing direct market access, voice-assisted technology, and transparent agricultural trade.
about.visionDesc: A digitally inclusive agricultural ecosystem where every Indian farmer has equitable access to buyers and fair market value.

contact.title: We're Here to Help
contact.subtitle: Have questions about crop listings, buyer bulk orders, or technical support? Contact our 24/7 helpline.
contact.whatsappDesc: Chat directly with our support team on WhatsApp
contact.phoneDesc: Mon - Sat from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM IST
contact.faq1A: Payments are processed securely via direct bank transfer or UPI once the buyer confirms delivery inspection.
contact.faq2Q: Is there a registration fee for farmers?
contact.faq2A: No, joining Farm2Market is completely free for all Indian farmers with zero upfront subscription costs.
contact.faq3Q: Can buyers request sample batches or negotiate bulk pricing?
contact.faq3A: Yes! Buyers can use the 'Chat on WhatsApp' button to speak directly with the farmer and agree on custom bulk orders.
